additionalInfo.description: Processes vibration sensor telemetry: filters, computes derived features, evaluates ISO 10816 thresholds, creates staged alarms, enriches with asset metadata, routes notifications by severity, and forwards to ML engine for fault classification.
Pass only telemetry messages from sensors with sensor_type == 'vibration'. All other message types fall through to the 'Other' chain.
Enriches telemetry with RMS mm/s, crest factor, ISO 10816 zone classification, and a 0-100 health score.
Stage 1 — borderline condition. Investigate at next scheduled maintenance window.
Stage 2 — schedule corrective maintenance within 2 weeks.
Stage 3/4 — immediate action required. Machine shutdown may be necessary.
Stage 1 alarm — rms 4.5–7.1 mm/s. Yellow status in dashboard.
Stage 2 alarm — rms 7.1–11.2 mm/s. Orange status in dashboard.
Stage 3/4 alarm — rms >11.2 mm/s or kurtosis >8. Red status. Immediate action.
Looks up the parent Machine asset's attributes (bearing type, criticality, nominal RPM) and adds them to the alarm message metadata for downstream routing decisions.

POSTs alarm context + vibration features to the ML engine for fault-type classification (imbalance / misalignment / bearing outer-race / looseness). Response is logged but not synchronously awaited in the rule chain to avoid latency.
Routes alarm messages to the appropriate notification node based on severity.
Sends email notification for WARNING and MAJOR severity alarms to the assigned maintainer.
Triggers SMS and PagerDuty notification for CRITICAL alarms via an external notification gateway.
Persists alarm event with full vibration feature context to PostgreSQL for historical analysis and CMMS integration.
